findings.title: Math.random() usage in UI animation particle coordinates and non-cryptographic mock card numbers
findings.details: Math.random() used strictly for visual confetti dispersion and cosmetic card ID numbers (#APX-XXXX), not security tokens.
findings.suppressionJustification: Accepted cosmetic randomness; security nonces and request hashes use crypto.subtle and crypto.createHash(sha256).

findings.title: Public Google OAuth Client ID in client build
findings.details: VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is a public OAuth 2.0 identifier required by Google Identity Services to render the user consent dialog.
findings.suppressionJustification: Public identifier by OAuth 2.0 PKCE design. No client secret is stored on client.
